evals.prompt: Implement this Figma frame in our Next.js app: https://www.figma.com/design/abc/App?node-id=12-34
evals.expected_output: Code that reuses project components and tokens, built after discovering available Figma tools, with screenshot comparison and an implementation note listing tools used, token mapping and gaps.
expectations: Lists which Figma MCP tools were available before using them
Calls get_screenshot or states why it could not
Maps Figma variables to existing project tokens and lists gaps instead of inventing names
Implementation note lists deviations and open questions

evals.prompt: Implement this Figma frame in SwiftUI, but the Figma MCP server is not connected. Here is a screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Works from the screenshot with an explicit list of values that could not be verified, without fabricating exact Figma values.
expectations: States that Figma MCP is unavailable and which checks cannot be done
Does not present guessed values as exact Figma values
Asks for the variable list or a spec
